summary: Lower arguments.length to the actual number of arguments supplied to the current non-arrow function.

target.notes: Count must reflect actual supplied argument count, including extras, and must differ from the number of formal parameters.

caveats: Deleting or redefining the arguments length property is observable if the arguments object escapes; this rule assumes canonical lowered arguments representation.
If code mutates or redefines arguments.length, use the full arguments-object helper rather than Count.
